features.title: By hand: Ubuntu 26.04 with a real fingerprint reader, from install to removal
features.description: On Ubuntu 26.04 with a real reader and no Custodio installed, a person follows only the documentation through the steps of acceptance 22 in docs/manual-acceptance.md: install notice, doctor naming what is missing, enable (pkexec takes the finger, sudo asks for the password), import a certificate exported from Firefox with the finger, register, sign in to a real site with the finger, list and completions, doctor reporting nothing, then delete, register --remove, fingerprint disable and package removal leaving the system as it was; the returned form is recorded.
